Create a high-fidelity implementable desktop website section concept for SalahSide, a native iPhone prayer times and optional Screen Time focus app. Website English. Warm ivory #f8f5ef background, dark forest #183b32 text, sage #426b55 actions, stone #d8cdbc borders. Sophisticated editorial serif headings (Georgia) and clean sans-serif body (Arial), spacious restrained architectural aesthetic. No invented statistics, testimonials, prices, claims, floating cards, hero eyebrows, pills, badges, glows, decorative icons, generic bento grids, or fake download links. Everything will be semantic native HTML/CSS, image is a concept only. Exact provided copy; use approved architecture imagery unchanged and the REAL attached Today screenshot unchanged when needed, do not invent app UI. Section 1 desktop first viewport, roughly 1440x1000. Header at top with SalahSide plain wordmark at left, How it works, Support, Privacy at right. Below, two-column hero with generous 80px sides. Left serif headline exactly 'A little less scrolling.\nA little more presence.' then body 'Make room for salah with prayer times, gentle reminders, and app focus on your iPhone.' Primary sage rounded button 'Explore SalahSide' with right arrow; small simple status below 'Coming soon to the App Store'. Right single phone frame containing attached actual Today screenshot at 270px wide; narrow pale stone elliptical shadow below. No invented phone UI. Small two-column feature strip below separated by hairline: 'Built around your prayers' / 'Set your city and prayer conventions.' and 'You choose the pause' / 'Choose apps to quiet, or keep Screen Time off.' Quiet editorial balance. Screenshot entire section readable.
